title: Keep Yourself in the Love of God
description: This sermon addresses the scenario where a believer humbly acknowledges a diminished affection for the Savior, a decreased appetite for Scripture, and a sense of distance from God. The focus is on the letter of Jude, emphasizing the need to contend for the faith amidst false teachings and to keep oneself in the love of God. The sermon highlights the importance of building up in faith, praying in the Holy Spirit, and waiting for the mercy of the Lord Jesus Christ as essential means to maintain a vibrant relationship with God.
